fib: ______ is the proportion or amount of diseased plants or parts in a population.
Disease incidence is the proportion or amount of diseased plants or parts in a population.
______ is any abnormal condition that damages a plant and reduces its productivity or usefulness to man.
Plant Disease is any abnormal condition that damages a plant and reduces its productivity or usefulness to man.
______ is a technique by which additives such as pesticides, nutrients or nitrifying bacteria can be applied to the seed's external surface (i.e. the testa).
Seed coating or film coating is a technique by which additives such as pesticides, nutrients or nitrifying bacteria can be applied to the seed's external surface (i.e. the testa).
______ is one of the most 21 important aspects of operating an agricultural enterprise especially food processing facility.
Sanitation is one of the most 21 important aspects of operating an agricultural enterprise especially food processing facility.
______ is the most common method of seed treatment.
Seed dressing is the most common method of seed treatment.
